Rules.InvariantScript:
Table(
    {Key:"Home", Label:"Home", IconKey:"home", SortOrder:1},
    {Key:"Overview", Label:"Overview", IconKey:"dashboard", SortOrder:2},
    {Key:"Tasks", Label:"Tasks", IconKey:"check", SortOrder:3},
    {Key:"Punches", Label:"Punches", IconKey:"warning", SortOrder:4},
    {Key:"Skyline", Label:"Skyline", IconKey:"timeline", SortOrder:5},
    {Key:"Config", Label:"Config", IconKey:"settings", SortOrder:6}
)

Switch(
    Lower(ThisItem.IconKey),
    "home", Icon.Home,
    "dashboard", Icon.Trending,
    "check", Icon.Check,
    "warning", Icon.Warning,
    "timeline", Icon.Clock,
    "settings", Icon.Settings,
    "table", Icon.DetailList,
    Icon.Information
)
